C0334.title: Jiaxing Yuhe Culture Media Exposed for Bulk Registering Short-Video Accounts Using IoT SIMs
C0334.summary: During the 2023 CCTV 315 Gala, Jiaxing Yuhe Culture Media Co., Ltd. was exposed for using IoT SIM cards to bulk-register accounts on short-video platforms for online marketing and fake engagement operations. This practice represents a typical case of fraudulent account registration on internet platforms using IoT SIMs.
